correctness.rationale: Uniform random matching is equivalently obtained by ranking n iid pairs of continuous uniform endpoints. For fixed chord length t, p_X=2t(1-t), p_N=t^2+2l(1-r), p_A=l^2+(1-r)^2; exact integration on 0<l<r<1 gives projection variances 1/45 and mixed projection covariance 0. Identical chord-pair indicators contribute -1/9 mixed covariance, disjoint pairs contribute zero and overlapping different pairs contribute zero, yielding Cov=-n(n-1)/18 and stated marginal/aligned moments. Hoeffding order-2 degenerate remainder is O(n^2) in L2, negligible under n^{3/2} scale, so iid vector CLT yields independent standard normals. Independently enumerated all (2n-1)!! matchings n=2..7 with exact rational moments; this is finite corroboration only.
residual_risks: Asymptotic independence does not imply finite independence; the exact covariance is negative for all n>=2.
